title: Primary Care Manager Settings and Access Standards - TRICARE Prime Tier Table
content:
Every **TRICARE Prime** tier fixes which kinds of provider may serve as the enrollee's primary care manager (PCM), the enrollee's access priority at a military hospital or clinic, whether a military PCM needs the facility's capacity approval, when a PCM change takes effect, the drive-time access standards, whether an access-standard waiver may be signed and the oldest age at which a pediatrics provider may be the PCM.

## Tier table

| Tier | PCM may be | Military hospital or clinic access priority group (1 is highest) | Military PCM needs the facility's capacity approval | A PCM change takes effect | Access-standard waiver may be signed |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| TRICARE Prime Active Duty Service Member | a military hospital or clinic | 1 | no | on the date the military clinic records the assignment | no |
| TRICARE Prime Remote Active Duty Service Member | a network primary care provider or a non-network participating provider | 1 | no | on the date of the request | no |
| TRICARE Prime Active Duty Family Member | a military hospital or clinic or a network primary care provider | 2 | yes | on the date of the request | yes |
| TRICARE Prime Remote Active Duty Family Member | a network primary care provider or a non-network participating provider | 2 | no | on the date of the request | no |
| TRICARE Prime Transitional Survivor | a military hospital or clinic or a network primary care provider | 2 | yes | on the date of the request | yes |
| TRICARE Prime Retiree Group A | a military hospital or clinic or a network primary care provider | 4 | yes | on the date of the request | yes |
| TRICARE Prime Retiree Group B | a military hospital or clinic or a network primary care provider | 4 | yes | on the date of the request | yes |

## Figures common to all seven tiers

| Standard | Figure |
|---|---|
| Maximum drive time from the residence to the PCM (primary care access standard) | 30 minutes |
| Maximum drive time from the residence to a referred specialist (specialty care access standard) | 60 minutes |
| Oldest age, in completed years, at which a pediatrics provider may serve as PCM | 17 |

## Points of reference

- The TRICARE Prime Active Duty Service Member tier lists a military hospital or clinic as its only PCM setting, while the two Prime Remote tiers list no military setting at all.
- The access priority group is a ranking: group 1 comes before group 2, and group 2 before group 4.
- An enrollee aged 17 in completed years may still have a pediatrics PCM under the age figure; at 18 the figure is exceeded.
